parameters.query: Rails input validation and sanitization best practices
parameters.snippet:
ruby
# Example of input validation and sanitization in Rails
def sanitize_input(input)
  ActionController::Base.helpers.sanitize(input)
end

# Usage in a controller action
def create
  sanitized_name = sanitize_input(params[:name])
  product = Product.new(name: sanitized_name, data: params[:data])
  if product.save
    render json: { message: 'Product successfully added' }, status: :created
  else
    render json: { error: 'Invalid input', details: product.errors.full_messages }, status: :bad_request
  end
end

# Example of a JSON validation in Ruby

def validate_json(json_string)
  begin
    JSON.parse(json_string)
    true
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    false
  end
end
